description: Controlled source test for cbrn_deploy_protective_aid and cbrn_deploy_protective_aid_sale. Every scenario binds ROOT to ENG and FROM to a named state, with State 16 owner FRA and controller GER except the explicit target-loss case. State population and concrete mask stock/ledger values are synthetic declared fixture values, not a save observation. The state target pool is incomplete because state_target = any may yield additional eligible states; therefore report willingness/raw_value traces and unresolved pool completeness, never a click probability. AI strategy-plan factors are not set unless the live evaluator discovers a supported binding.
